title: Understanding the organization and its context
paraphrase: The organisation determines external and internal issues relevant to its purpose that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcomes of the AI management system including its role as AI provider or AI user.

title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
paraphrase: The organisation determines the interested parties relevant to the AI management system and their relevant requirements.

title: Determining the scope of the AI management system
paraphrase: The boundaries and applicability of the AI management system are determined and documented.

title: AI management system
paraphrase: The organisation establishes implements maintains and continually improves an AI management system including the processes needed and their interactions.

title: Leadership and commitment
paraphrase: Top management demonstrates leadership and commitment with respect to the AI management system.

title: AI policy
paraphrase: Top management establishes an AI policy appropriate to the purpose of the organisation that provides a framework for setting AI objectives and commits to continual improvement.

title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
paraphrase: Top management ensures that responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned and communicated.

title: Actions to address risks and opportunities - general
paraphrase: When planning the AI management system the organisation considers the issues and requirements identified and determines the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed.

title: AI risk assessment
paraphrase: The organisation defines and applies an AI risk assessment process that establishes risk criteria identifies analyses and evaluates AI risks and produces consistent valid and comparable results.

title: AI risk treatment
paraphrase: The organisation defines and applies an AI risk treatment process to select treatment options determine necessary controls and produce a Statement of Applicability.

title: AI system impact assessment
paraphrase: The organisation defines a process to assess the potential consequences of AI systems for individuals groups and societies throughout the system life cycle.

title: AI objectives and planning to achieve them
paraphrase: AI objectives are established at relevant functions and levels consistent with the AI policy measurable monitored and updated as appropriate.

title: Planning of changes
paraphrase: Changes to the AI management system are carried out in a planned manner.

title: Resources
paraphrase: The organisation determines and provides the resources needed for the AI management system.

title: Competence
paraphrase: The organisation determines the necessary competence of persons affecting AI performance and ensures they are competent on the basis of education training or experience.

title: Awareness
paraphrase: Persons doing work under the organisation's control are aware of the AI policy their contribution to the AI management system and the implications of not conforming.

title: Communication
paraphrase: The organisation determines the internal and external communications relevant to the AI management system including what when with whom and how to communicate.

title: Documented information - general
paraphrase: The AI management system includes documented information required by the standard and determined by the organisation as necessary for effectiveness.

title: Creating and updating documented information
paraphrase: Documented information is appropriately identified described formatted reviewed and approved.

title: Control of documented information
paraphrase: Documented information is available where needed and adequately protected including control of distribution access retrieval storage retention and disposition.

title: Operational planning and control
paraphrase: The organisation plans implements and controls the processes needed to meet requirements and to implement the actions determined in planning.

title: AI risk assessment
paraphrase: The organisation performs AI risk assessments at planned intervals and when significant changes are proposed or occur and retains documented information on the results.

title: AI risk treatment
paraphrase: The organisation implements the AI risk treatment plan and retains documented information of the results.

title: AI system impact assessment
paraphrase: The organisation performs AI system impact assessments at planned intervals and retains documented information on the results.

title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
paraphrase: The organisation determines what needs to be monitored and measured the methods to be used and when monitoring measuring analysis and evaluation are performed.

title: Internal audit - general
paraphrase: The organisation conducts internal audits at planned intervals to determine whether the AI management system conforms to requirements and is effectively implemented and maintained.

title: Internal audit programme
paraphrase: An audit programme is planned established implemented and maintained including frequency methods responsibilities and reporting.

title: Management review - general
paraphrase: Top management reviews the AI management system at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability adequacy and effectiveness.

title: Management review inputs
paraphrase: The management review considers the status of prior actions changes in issues and requirements AI performance audit results and opportunities for improvement.

title: Management review results
paraphrase: The results of the management review include decisions related to continual improvement opportunities and any need for changes to the AI management system.

title: Continual improvement
paraphrase: The organisation continually improves the suitability adequacy and effectiveness of the AI management system.

title: Nonconformity and corrective action
paraphrase: When a nonconformity occurs the organisation reacts to it evaluates the need for action to eliminate its causes implements action and reviews effectiveness.

title: AI policy
paraphrase: The organisation documents an AI policy that is approved by management and establishes the organisation's intentions and direction for responsible development and use of AI.

title: Alignment with other organizational policies
paraphrase: The AI policy is aligned with other organisational policies such as information security privacy quality and safety so that requirements do not conflict.

title: Review of the AI policy
paraphrase: The AI policy is reviewed at planned intervals or when significant changes occur to ensure continuing suitability adequacy and effectiveness.

title: AI roles and responsibilities
paraphrase: Roles and responsibilities for AI are defined and allocated across the organisation including accountability for AI system outcomes.

title: Reporting of concerns
paraphrase: A mechanism is provided for personnel and other interested parties to report concerns about the organisation's AI systems.

title: Resource documentation
paraphrase: The organisation identifies and documents the resources required for activities at each AI system life cycle stage.

title: Data resources
paraphrase: Data resources used for AI systems are documented including their characteristics and intended role.

title: Tooling resources
paraphrase: Tooling resources used in the development and operation of AI systems are documented.

title: System and computing resources
paraphrase: System and computing resources used for AI systems are documented including infrastructure needed across the life cycle.

title: Human resources
paraphrase: Human resources and the competences required for AI activities are documented including specialist skills.

title: AI system impact assessment process
paraphrase: A process is established to assess the potential consequences of AI systems for individuals groups and society throughout the life cycle.

title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
paraphrase: The results of AI system impact assessments are documented and retained.

title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals and groups of individuals
paraphrase: The potential impacts of the AI system on individuals and groups of individuals are assessed including impacts on health safety and fundamental rights.

title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
paraphrase: The potential broader societal impacts of AI systems are assessed including environmental economic and social effects.

title: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
paraphrase: Objectives for the responsible development of AI systems are defined and documented.

title: Processes for responsible design and development of AI systems
paraphrase: Processes for the responsible design and development of AI systems are defined and implemented.

title: AI system requirements and specification
paraphrase: Requirements for the AI system are specified including functional performance and trustworthiness requirements.

title: Documentation of AI system design and development
paraphrase: The design and development of the AI system is documented including design decisions and their rationale.

title: AI system verification and validation
paraphrase: Verification and validation measures for the AI system are defined and performed and the results documented.

title: AI system deployment
paraphrase: A deployment plan is defined and requirements are met before the AI system is deployed into operational use.

title: AI system operation and monitoring
paraphrase: The AI system is operated and monitored in accordance with defined requirements including ongoing performance monitoring after deployment.

title: AI system technical documentation
paraphrase: Technical documentation for the AI system is produced and maintained for relevant interested parties.

title: AI system recording of event logs
paraphrase: The AI system automatically records event logs during its operation and logs are retained for a defined period.

title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
paraphrase: The organisation defines and documents the data management process for data used to develop and enhance AI systems.

title: Acquisition of data
paraphrase: Data acquired for AI systems is obtained in accordance with defined requirements including legal and contractual constraints.

title: Quality of data for AI systems
paraphrase: The quality of data used in AI systems is defined assessed and maintained including relevance representativeness and accuracy.

title: Data provenance
paraphrase: The provenance of data used in AI systems is recorded and maintained including origin and transformations applied.

title: Data preparation
paraphrase: Data preparation methods applied to data used in AI systems are defined and documented.

title: System documentation and information for users
paraphrase: Documentation is provided to users of the AI system so they can understand its capabilities limitations and appropriate use.

title: External reporting
paraphrase: A capability is provided for interested parties to report adverse impacts of the AI system externally.

title: Communication of incidents
paraphrase: A process is defined for communicating AI system incidents to relevant interested parties.

title: Information for interested parties
paraphrase: Information about the AI system is made available to interested parties as appropriate to their role and needs.

title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
paraphrase: Processes for the responsible use of AI systems are defined and implemented.

title: Objectives for responsible use of AI system
paraphrase: Objectives for the responsible use of the AI system are defined and documented.

title: Intended use of the AI system
paraphrase: The intended use of the AI system is defined and the system is used in accordance with that intended use and its documented limitations.

title: Allocating responsibilities
paraphrase: Responsibilities are allocated between the organisation and third parties across the AI system life cycle.

title: Suppliers
paraphrase: Requirements are established for suppliers of AI systems components or services and supplier conformance is assessed.

title: Customers
paraphrase: The organisation's responsibilities to customers of its AI systems are defined including information provided to them.
